_about: Mildred A. Wirt, American author, for the Word Hoard. Added 2026-11-15 by the non-renewal sweep, batch 8 (Adam 2026-11-03: "I want everything that was not renewed"): the Gutenberg texts of Mildred A. Wirt's 1931-1963 books that were never renewed, each checked in NYPL's cce-renewals. No uids minted. Mildred Wirt (later Mildred Wirt Benson) wrote the first Nancy Drew books as 'Carolyn Keene'; these are her books under her own name.
